name: 5-MMPA
summary: 5-Methylmethiopropamine (5-MMPA, mephedrene) is a stimulant drug which is a ring-substituted derivative of methiopropamine. It is not a substituted cathinone derivative like mephedrone, as it lacks a ketone group at the β position of the aliphatic side chain, but instead more closely resembles substituted amphetamines. It has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Germany in June 2020.

uses.text: It has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Germany in June 2020.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Its parent methiopropamine blocks the reuptake of noradrenaline and dopamine, and it is thought to work in a similar way.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。它的母體methiopropamine會阻斷正腎上腺素與多巴胺的回收，一般認為它的作用方式相似。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。它的母体methiopropamine会阻断正肾上腺素与多巴胺的回收，一般认为它的作用方式相似。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, loss of appetite, insomnia, anxiety and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、食慾不振、失眠、焦慮，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、食欲不振、失眠、焦虑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: Its nickname mephedrene is misleading. It has no ketone group, so it is not a cathinone like mephedrone, and its core ring is a sulphur-containing thiophene rather than benzene.
fact.zh: 它的暱稱「mephedrene」其實容易誤導。它沒有酮基，所以不像喵喵那樣屬於卡西酮，而且它核心的環是含硫的噻吩，而不是苯環。
fact.zhHans: 它的暱称「mephedrene」其实容易误导。它没有酮基，所以不像喵喵那样属于卡西酮，而且它内核的环是含硫的噻吩，而不是苯环。
